9i2tovq7n2ipeu9d5d45sk1nd6.value: Credits: the birds flock by Craig Reynolds's boids (Flocks, herds and schools, SIGGRAPH 1987), looking only at their own cell of a grid and the 26 around it; random numbers by Stephen Park and Keith Miller's minimal standard generator (1988); a fixed step after Glenn Fiedler's Fix Your Timestep (2004).

aamed530j3kk1gkr5f99ipgq75.value: Two thousand birds, each looking only at the birds within ten metres: keep apart, fly as they do, stay together. A roaming point draws the whole flock round the box. Arrows or WASD turn the camera; click the sky first.
